title: Hikari's Castaway
description: A vanilla extension that adds a bunch to your vanilla world.
body:
# Main information

## What is Castaway?

Castaway is a generic minecraft mod that builds itself upon adding content that make minecraft a little more fun for players. Ranging from new structures giving the opportunity for players to explore around the world and face off challenges, to finding new ores giving players to craft tools, armor, and decorative blocks.

This mod is fit for players that want an adventure, a challenge, or wanting more of what minecraft could be.

## What does this mod have?

Currently Castaway features
- Structures, all having randomly generated loot.
- new ores, such as titanium, cobalt, silver and steel.
- a bunch of quality of life changes such as smelting raw iron blocks to become full iron block or being able to craft items that aren't unlockable in survival mode.
- new biomes. 
- new dimensions
and tons more to come as this mod develops, and every new type of content will be added here. to give new tourists a list on what to expect in this mod.
## Installation Guide

Although there isn't many options yet for this mod. I recommend you installing it on what it's intended loader it is supposed to be and that is **neoforge**.

## Dependencies

This mod requires Curios API to function. Link below:
https://modrinth.com/project/vvuO3ImH

# Side information (optional)

## Interested? 

If you are interested in Castaway's mod development, I recommend joining our [Community Server](https://discord.gg/4sUpXTq2H3)!

And if you want to support me, as I am a solo dev working on the mod consider [buying me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/hikariaki) 
Tips and donations, will help me support my development on the mod and other future development for other mods.
